hints.title: Traverse Level by Level
hints.text: A level order traversal allows inspecting nodes on each level together with level index.

hints.title: Parity Condition
hints.text: Even levels must contain strictly odd integers, while odd levels must contain strictly even integers.

hints.title: Monotonicity Condition
hints.text: Even levels must be strictly increasing from left to right, while odd levels must be strictly decreasing.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is number of nodes in tree
w is maximum width of tree
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursion without level tracking requires threading level index and sorting by level.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Standard level order traversal processes all nodes in O(n) time and O(w) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check both parity and strict monotonicity at each step.

solutions.approach: Breadth first search level order traversal with parity and monotonicity checks
